description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: April 1, 2026 SACRAMENTO, CA – Congressmember Doris Matsui has rejected a Sacramento Bee invitation to publicly debate Councilmember Mai Vang before ballots drop in May. Vang continues to call on Matsui to commit to at least one public debate ahead of the early vote period.
title: Matsui Declines Debate Challenge, Vang Continues Showing Up — Mai Vang for Congress
